mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO doc_chunk (document_id, kb_id, seq, content, embedding) values
(#{c.documentId}, #{c.kbId}, #{c.seq}, #{c.content}, #{c.embedding})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.document_id, d.name AS document_name, c.content, c.section_path, c.embedding FROM doc_chunk c JOIN document d ON d.id = c.document_id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE c.kb_id = #{kbId} AND c.embedding IS NOT NULL
